chunks: Al-Hasan ibn Ahmad narrated to me from his father who said: Muhammad ibn Ahmad narrated to me who said: Muhammad ibn Abdullah narrated to me from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Uthman, and Abu Uthman his name is Abd al-Wahid ibn Habib, who said: Muhammad ibn Abi Hamzah al-Thumali claimed to us from Muawiyah ibn Ammar al-Duhni from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
The night prayer beautifies the face, improves the character, makes the body fragrant, increases sustenance, pays off the debt, removes sorrow, and clears the eyesight.
ai.seo_question: What are the benefits of night prayer in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Recorded by Shaykh al-Saduq in *Thawab al-A'mal*, this hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) emphasizes the holistic benefits of Salat al-Layl, linking spiritual devotion to tangible worldly and physical improvements. It underscores the Shia tradition of *barakah* manifesting in enhanced facial radiance, refined character, and the alleviation of material burdens like debt and anxiety.

en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 8. It was narrated to me by al-Hassan b. Ahmad from his father who said it was narrated to me by Muhammad b. Ahmad who said it was narrated to me by Muhammad b. Abdillah from Ahmad b. al-Hassan b. Ali b. Uthman and Abu Uthman his name is Abd al-Wahid b. Habeeb who said claimed to us Muhammad b. Abi Hamzah al-Thumali from Muawiyah b. Ammar al-Duhni from Abi Abdillah (a.s.) who said: “
Salaat-e-Shab beautifies one’s face, improves one’s character, fragrances the body and increases earnings. It helps in repayment of debts, removal of sorrows and improves eyesight.”
